THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
141
STUDY 150
Ribbed Off-Shoulder Zip Top & Heart Belt
Rights check
Source: 25045.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy dark hair
wears a dusty blue ribbed off-shoulder top with a center
zip and a flared sleeve cuff. A bold silver heart-shaped
belt buckle sits over washed-out dark jeans. Long drop
earrings and a sleek choker complete the look. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light
against a pale gray backdrop. Palette of dusty blue,
washed denim, and silver. Relaxed and cool, in the
style of a fashion-forward street-style lookbook.
Relaxed, cool, fashion-forward
WORKING NOTES
- The off-shoulder zip top and heart buckle are the
defining details.
- Keep the washed denim for a relaxed, lived-in look.
Try this: Keep the washed denim for a relaxed feel.
